summary: Locale-sensitive string mapping (LCMapString) with automatic code-page conversion. Lazily detects at runtime whether the platform maps wide strings (mode 1) or only ANSI (mode 2). Mode 2 calls LCMapStringA directly. Mode 1 converts the source to wide chars, maps with LCMapStringW, and either writes a sortkey directly to the destination (when the 0x400 flag is set) or converts the wide result back to the destination code page with WideCharToMultiByte. Returns the mapped length or 0 on any failure.

operations.description: Lazy runtime mode detection: when the mode global dword_8D3FBC is zero, probe LCMapStringW against the wide test string String2; success records mode 1, otherwise probe LCMapStringA against String1 and record mode 2, returning 0 when both probes fail.
When the source length cchSrc is positive, bound it through BoundedStringLengthWithCap.
Mode 2 (ANSI-only platform): call LCMapStringA directly with the given locale and flags and return its result.
Mode 1 path: when the caller-supplied CodePage is zero substitute the default CodePage global.
Query the required wide-char buffer size via MultiByteToWideChar, using conversion flags 9 when a8 is non-zero else 1; bail out returning 0 on failure.
Size a working buffer on the stack (2 * length + 3 aligned down to a 4-byte boundary) via alloca, then set the compiler SEH try-level state for the frame.
Convert the source ANSI string into the wide-character stack buffer with MultiByteToWideChar; bail out returning 0 on failure.
Map the wide string with LCMapStringW to obtain the mapped length; bail out returning 0 on failure.
Sortkey path: when dwMapFlags has the 0x400 bit set, map directly into the destination buffer and validate the length fits cchDest.
Otherwise map into a wide buffer and convert the result back to the destination code page with WideCharToMultiByte; bail out returning 0 on failure.
Return the mapped length computed by the active branch, or 0 when any step failed.

clean_pseudocode: // Locale map string with code-page conversion; wide vs ANSI detected once at runtime.
int sub_591FA1(LCID locale, DWORD flags, const char* src, int srcLen,
char* dst, int dstLen, UINT cp, int a8) {
if (g_wideMode == 2) return LCMapStringA(locale, flags, src, srcLen, dst, dstLen);
int n = MultiByteToWideChar(cp, a8 ? 9 : 1, src, srcLen, 0, 0);
if (!MultiByteToWideChar(cp, 1, src, srcLen, wide, n)) return 0;
int m = LCMapStringW(locale, flags, wide, n, 0, 0);
if (dstLen && (m > dstLen || !LCMapStringW(locale, flags, wide, n, (LPWSTR)dst, dstLen))) return 0;
if (!LCMapStringW(locale, flags, wide, n, mapped, m)) return 0;
int out = WideCharToMultiByte(cp, 0x220, mapped, m, dst, dstLen, 0, 0);
